lines.1: But asking any more intrusive questions would only make her angry.
lines.2: Maybe Yashi had been a little more talkative because we were in such unusual circumstances.
lines.3: The vacation effect was not to be underestimated.
lines.4: I felt as though the distance between us had narrowed a little.
lines.6: Even after all her insults, looking out for her as a senior had been worthwhile.
lines.8: ...For some reason, Yashi stayed on my mind.
